items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: We played the theme song and the boy played the second chorus on the piano

ctx.x: On the Dixon. Oh yes, you mean on the way to New York.

Soon we played the theme song everybody stood up and asked if I wanted the job. We played the theme song and the boy played the second chorus on the piano and everybody stood up and said never heard nothing like that.
One time I had the idea he was mostly just a solo pianist, you know like playing by himself. Was he good in a band?
